subject: Modify clusterSaveConfig function call to use C_OK / C_ERR return value (#818)
reason: Pure cosmetic refactor: the change substitutes the macros C_OK/C_ERR for the literals 0/-1 in two comparisons of clusterSaveConfig's return value (clusterSaveConfigOrDie and CLUSTER SAVECONFIG) and updates a comment. server.h defines C_OK as 0 and C_ERR as -1, so the compiled behaviour is identical on both the success and error paths; there is no observable behaviour to test and no scenario can distinguish the two builds.
